answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 118 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a nectar bet on surviving 118 epochs of grading, and every ember settlement recomputes the zenith schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
